terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body:
Welcome to Pathway (the "Platform"). By accessing or using the Platform, you agree to these terms.

1. Services
The Platform provides career exploration, AI-assisted assessment, and human coaching bookings. AI-generated content is for reference only and does not constitute career, legal, or financial advice.

2. Accounts
You must register with a valid, accurate email address and are responsible for all activity under your account. Keep your password secure and contact us immediately if you notice unauthorized use. Multiple accounts created to circumvent limits are not permitted.

3. Coaches and bookings
Coaches must submit genuine identity and credential documents and pass Platform review before being listed. The Platform does not guarantee specific outcomes from coaching, but will help resolve booking disputes. Learners should confirm time and communication method before booking.

4. Payments
The Platform charges no fees during the beta and does not currently offer online payments. After you submit a booking, the Platform will confirm it manually. If paid services launch in future, we will publish pricing, payment methods, and refund rules in advance.

5. Cancellations and refunds
Refund rules are set out in the Refund Policy.

6. Acceptable use
You may not post unlawful, infringing, discriminatory, harassing, or false content, or bypass Platform payments or transact privately. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these rules.

7. Intellectual property
Platform content (other than user-uploaded content) belongs to the Platform. Resumes and documents you upload are used solely to provide the service, and you retain ownership of them.

8. Limitation of liability
To the extent permitted by law, the Platform is not liable for indirect losses arising from use of the service.

9. Changes
We may update these terms and will notify you of material changes via the site or email. Continued use constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

10. Contact
Operator: Pathway (independently operated by an individual developer). For questions, complaints, or refund requests, email support@yourpathwayai.com — we reply within 3 business days.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
We take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how Pathway collects, uses, transfers, and protects your personal information.

1. Information we collect
- Account: name, email, and password (securely stored by Firebase Authentication).
- Profile: current role, target direction, skills, interests, and assessment answers.
- Resumes and documents: files you upload and the text extracted from them.
- Booking data: booking records, communications, and status.
- Usage data: page views and clicks collected through our self-hosted analytics.

2. How we use it
To provide career assessments, recommend paths, match coaches, process bookings, improve the product, and keep the Platform secure.

3. AI processing
Your profile, assessment answers, and resume text are sent to AI models to generate reports and coach replies. We do not use your personal information to train public third-party models. AI-generated content is for reference only and does not constitute career, legal, psychological, or financial advice.

4. Sharing
We share information only: with your chosen coach as needed to deliver the booking (never the raw resume); or as required by law or regulators. We do not currently offer online payments and do not share payment data with payment providers. If online payments launch, we will notify you separately.

5. Cross-border transfer
Your personal information (including resume, assessment answers, and chat history) is transferred to servers in Hong Kong and outside mainland China, processed by:
- Google (Firebase / Gemini): authentication, database and file storage, AI report and chat generation;
- Zhipu AI: backup model for reports and replies when Gemini is unavailable;
- Resend: transactional email such as verification and booking notices.
This processing is necessary to provide the service. You may decline at sign-up, or withdraw consent at any time in privacy settings or by email. Withdrawal stops future processing but does not affect processing already completed.

6. Retention
- Account data: while your account is active; purged on a rolling backup cycle after deletion;
- Resumes: deleted from production storage within 30 days after you delete them;
- Anonymous resumes: automatically deleted 30 days after upload;
- Chat history: 12 months;
- Analytics data: 12 months;
- Coach applications and review materials: 2 years after the coaching relationship ends, used only for review and dispute handling.

7. Anonymous use
You can complete the assessment and upload a resume without registering. Anonymous data is isolated under a random identifier and is not linked to identity information you have not provided; anonymous resumes are deleted after 30 days. If you register later, the anonymous assessment results are merged into your account profile.

8. Self-hosted analytics
We use self-hosted analytics to record page views, button clicks, and flow completion for product improvement. Analytics data does not include resume text, chat content, ID numbers, or other sensitive information, and is retained for 12 months. We do not use third-party advertising trackers.

9. Coach materials for review only
Education and work-history documents submitted by coaches are used solely for Platform review and dispute handling. They are not shown publicly or used for marketing.

10. Minors
This service is intended for users aged 18 or older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors and will delete any such data promptly if discovered.

11. Storage and security
Data is stored on Google Cloud (Firebase) and servers in Hong Kong, with access controls and encrypted transport. We retain data as needed for the service and as required by law.

12. Your rights
You can view, edit, or delete your profile and resumes at any time and request account deletion. After deletion, data is removed from production (backups are purged on a rolling schedule).

13. Cookies
We use essential local storage to keep you signed in and remember preferences. We do not use third-party advertising trackers.

14. Contact
Operator: Pathway (independently operated by an individual developer). To exercise these rights or ask privacy questions, email support@yourpathwayai.com — we reply within 3 business days.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.notice: The beta is free of charge, so this policy does not currently apply.
refund.body:
To protect both learners and coaches, the following refund rules apply.

1. Coach has not confirmed
If the coach does not confirm before the session or declines the booking, you receive a full refund and the slot is released automatically.

2. Learner cancellation
- More than 24 hours before a confirmed session: full refund.
- Within 24 hours of the session: no refund; you may ask the coach to reschedule.
- Bookings not yet confirmed by the coach: cancel anytime for a full refund.

3. No-shows
If the learner does not attend without notice, the session is treated as completed and is non-refundable. If the coach does not attend, you receive a full refund plus a Platform credit.

4. Quality disputes
If you're unhappy with a session, submit details within 7 days. We will review within 5 business days and issue a partial or full refund where warranted.

5. Packages
5-session packages are redeemed per session. Used sessions are non-refundable; unused sessions may be refunded pro rata within 90 days of purchase.

6. Refund timing
Refunds are returned to the original payment method (if online payments launch in future), typically within 5–10 business days depending on your card issuer.

7. Disputed transactions
If you notice a duplicate or unauthorized charge, contact us immediately and we'll prioritize the case.

8. Contact
Operator: Pathway (independently operated by an individual developer). For refund questions, email support@yourpathwayai.com with your booking reference — we reply within 3 business days.
